abilities.critical_failure: The creature is buried in the rubble. They take 3d10+19 bludgeoning damage and are restrained (Escape DC 25). Until they escape, the creature must hold their breath or risk suffocating.
abilities.effect: The ceiling and walls of the cell collapse, creating a thunderous roar. All creatures in the cell must attempt a DC 25 Reflex save; the cell then becomes greater difficult terrain that can be passed through safely.
abilities.failure: The creature takes 2d10+13 bludgeoning damage and is immobilized by fallen rubble (Escape DC 25).
abilities.name: Collapse
abilities.trigger: A Medium or larger creature moves through the cell at a faster pace than simply Stepping, or more than one Medium or larger creature enter the cell at the same time

hazard.description: A section of ceiling and iron cell bars collapse inward.
hazard.disable: DC 22 Thievery (trained) or DC 25 Crafting (trained) to use a loose iron bar to shore up the ceiling.
hazard.name: Collapsing Cell

traits.name: Rare
traits.text: This rarity indicates that a rules element is very difficult to find in the game world. A rare feat, spell, item or the like is available to players only if the GM decides to include it in the game, typically through discovery during play. Creatures with this trait are rare. They typically can't be summoned. The DC of Recall Knowledge checks related to these creatures is increased by 5.

traits.name: Environmental
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is something dangerous that’s part of the natural world, such as quicksand or harmful mold.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard constructed to hinder interlopers.
